- **Direct play for MKV and MP4.** SlopFin now reads these files straight from
  your Jellyfin library instead of asking the server to repackage every film.
  The server does no FFmpeg work for them, so playback starts even when the
  server's transcoding is broken or slow.
- **Faster, exact seeking.** A seek reads from the file's own index and lands
  on the frame you chose; on the test console it took 0.4–1.6 s, against about
  2.1 s through the server, which only reached its nearest keyframe.
- **Artwork kept on the SSD.** Posters and backdrops are saved after their
  first download, so Home appears at once on the next launch. The cache keeps
  itself under 1 GB, removing the oldest pictures first.
- **The Unwatched button works.** On a title's page it used to mark the title
  watched again instead of clearing it.
- **Clearer playback errors.** "The server would not start the stream" is
  replaced by the actual cause and what to do about it: the server's FFmpeg
  failing (HTTP 500), a refused sign-in or permission, a missing file, or an
  unreachable server.

**What still goes through the server:** image subtitles that must be drawn
into the picture, audio the PS5 cannot decode as stored (for example FLAC,
Opus, or TrueHD with PS5 software audio off), a chosen audio conversion, a
quality limit below the source, and other containers such as AVI. Text
subtitles, audio passthrough and the existing audio options work as before.
A file that can't be read directly falls back to the server automatically.

Direct play was checked against FFmpeg's own output, with B-frames, 10-bit
HDR10, both MP4 layouts and all three MKV lacing modes. On firmware 8.20 it
played a real library over HTTPS: 4K60 and 1080p HEVC, H.264, AAC and
E-AC-3 passthrough. That run included five minutes without a dropped frame or
an audio gap, text subtitles, end of episode with autoplay, and repeated
seeks. MP4 has been checked against FFmpeg but not yet played from a real
library on the console.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
